zh.title: 影響力
zh.lead: 以研究數據與前線聲音，看見「腦細話事」為老師、學生和社區帶來的改變。

research.partner: 香港理工大學護理學院
research.lead: 理大護理學院跟進研究，涵蓋 4 次工作坊前後評估及 2 個月跨時間追蹤，量度計劃對老師信心與課室支援能力的影響。

stats.label: 更理解學生精神健康需要

items.p: 設身處地，從學生或同事的角度感受一個情景。
與同事合作搭建大腦模型，把腦科學變成看得見、摸得到的東西。
抽出事件卡，一起走進真實課室裡可能發生的時刻。
練習具體的支持說話，再與引導師一起反思。

message.quote: 「腦細話事」透過創傷知情及腦神經科學的角度，協助參加者理解學生的需要，成為他們成長路上堅實的後盾。
message.name: Dr. Andy Fung
message.role: 香港理工大學護理學院 研究助理教授

items.quote: 回想起我的教學初心，且首次明白如何以同理心回應，而非急於解決問題。
更深入理解老師們面對的困難，是加深認識和互相學習的好機會。
透過角色扮演借鏡同事經驗。培訓加深彼此連結，建立互助文化。

en.title: Impact
en.lead: Research data and voices from the frontline show the change Brainy In-Charge brings to teachers, students and communities.

research.partnerSub: 香港理工大學護理學院
research.lead: The School of Nursing at PolyU follows the programme with research, using 4 pre- and post-workshop assessments and 2 months of longitudinal follow-up to measure its effect on teachers’ confidence and classroom support skills.

stats.label: Better understanding of students’ mental health needs

orbit.hint: Tap an icon to explore each step

items.p: Step into a student’s or colleague’s shoes and feel a situation from the inside.
Build a brain model together, so brain science becomes something you can see and touch.
Draw an event card and walk through a moment that could really happen in a classroom.
Practise supportive things to say, then reflect with the facilitator.

message.h: A message from Dr. Andy Fung
message.quote: Through trauma-informed and neuroscience perspectives, “Brainy” helps participants understand students’ needs and become a reliable source of support as they grow.
message.name: Dr. Andy Fung
message.role: Research Assistant Professor, School of Nursing, PolyU

items.quote: It reminded me of my purpose as a teacher, and I learned to respond with empathy rather than rush to solve problems.
